question: Should this broad memory-consistency issue remain the umbrella tracker, be closed in favor of narrower trackers like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95724, or define a new canonical memory contract proposal?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested fix would add or reshape public config and plugin API surface across memory roles, QMD/builtin backend selection, compaction flush, and persistent storage scoping.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either land the role-slot/storage pieces or write a canonical memory-contract design that covers the reporter's consistency problem.

options.title: Split To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close this only after maintainers explicitly confirm the remaining pieces are fully tracked by narrower issues such as role slots, source-keyed SQLite indexes, bounded writes, and memory MVP commands.

options.title: Reject New Memory Type Surface
options.body: Close as not planned only if maintainers decide current memory.backend plus plugin slots and targeted docs/doctor improvements are the intended permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either land the role-slot/storage pieces or write a canonical memory-contract design that covers the reporter's consistency problem.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting product/API decision about OpenClaw's memory contract rather than a single-file implementation choice.
